name: Soft Daylight
description: A fresh everyday face with bright under-eyes and a sheer rosy cheek, in about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, neutral medium
steps.tip: Press a thin layer from the center of your face outward with a damp sponge. Keep it light on the jaw so your natural skin still shows through.

steps.title: Concealer, light neutral
steps.tip: Tap this under the eyes in a small triangle to soften dark circles and puffy eyes. Add a tiny touch directly over spots, then blend only the edges so coverage stays clean.

steps.title: Blush, soft round pink
steps.tip: Place the color on the apples of your cheeks and blend slightly upward. Keep the shape round and soft so it looks fresh, not sculpted.

steps.title: Highlighter, soft glow
steps.tip: Sweep a small amount across the tops of your cheekbones and a touch on the brow bone. Use your fingertip so the glow stays smooth on normal skin.

steps.title: Lip color, muted rose
steps.tip: Blur the color onto the center of your lips first, then fill outward for a soft, natural edge. If you want extra polish, pat once with a finger to keep it even.

name: Warm Lift
description: A brighter lifted face with peach warmth and polished skin, in about 14 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, soft warm medium
steps.tip: Sheer the foundation across the T-zone first, then bounce it out over the cheeks. This keeps shine controlled without flattening your normal skin.

steps.title: Concealer, beige sand
steps.tip: Use a small brush to place concealer only where dark circles and puffy eyes show most. Tap the product into the inner corners and under the outer eye so the lift looks natural.

steps.title: Bronzer, soft golden
steps.tip: Dust bronzer along the tops of your cheeks, temples, and a little along the jaw. Keep the pressure light so the warmth reads as healthy, not muddy.

steps.title: Blush, lifted peach
steps.tip: Sweep the blush diagonally from the outer cheek toward the temple. This lifted placement gives your face an instant brighter angle.

steps.title: Lip color, peach nude
steps.tip: Trace your natural lip line first, then fill the center with a soft peach nude. Leave a little extra sheen on the center of the lower lip for fullness.

name: Polished Shape
description: A medium glam look with defined eyes and a smooth sculpted cheek, in about 18 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, true medium
steps.tip: Buff the base in thin layers until redness and spots are evened out. Stop before it looks heavy so your skin still has dimension.

steps.title: Concealer, light beige
steps.tip: Conceal the under-eye hollow first, then place a little more where dark circles and puffy eyes are deepest. Use the tip of the sponge to press, not drag, so the finish stays smooth.

steps.title: Contour, soft oval
steps.tip: Fit the contour just under the cheekbones and blend upward with a small brush. Keep it soft so it adds shape without looking harsh on medium skin.

steps.title: Blush, rosy diagonal
steps.tip: Start just above the cheek hollow and sweep toward the ear. This longer diagonal blush shape adds lift and balances the contour.

steps.title: Eyebrows, soft arch
steps.tip: Fill sparse areas with short hairlike strokes, then brush the brow upward and outward. Keep the front lighter so the brows stay soft and believable.

steps.title: Lip color, rosewood
steps.tip: Apply from the center of the mouth outward, then soften the edges with a fingertip. The rosewood tone will echo your natural lip color while still looking polished.

name: Soft Smoke
description: A deeper eye look with balanced cheeks and a richer lip, in about 22 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, balanced medium
steps.tip: Layer the foundation where spots show first, then sheer it across the rest of the face. This gives coverage while keeping the texture smooth and even.

steps.title: Concealer, warm beige
steps.tip: Brighten the under-eye area with a thin layer, then tap a little extra on the darkest circles and puffy areas. Blend the edges upward so the eye area looks lifted.

steps.title: Eye shadow, warm taupe
steps.tip: Smudge the shadow over the whole lid and slightly above the crease for a smoky shape. Keep the center a touch lighter so the eye does not close in.

steps.title: Eye liner, brown define
steps.tip: Draw a thin line as close to the lash roots as possible, then make the outer third a little thicker. Let the wing stay short so the smoke remains soft, not sharp.

steps.title: Eyelashes, fluttery lift
steps.tip: Place the lashes slightly higher at the outer corners to open the eye shape. Press them into the liner once the glue gets tacky so they stay secure.

steps.title: Blush, peach flush
steps.tip: Apply the blush in a soft heart shape centered on the apples of the cheeks. Diffuse the top edges so it reads warm and romantic, not cartoonish.

steps.title: Lip color, muted berry
steps.tip: Fill the lips from the center outward, then blur the outline with a brush for a softer finish. The berry tone will balance the smoked eyes without overpowering the face.

name: Evening Wing
description: A dramatic lifted glam with bold liner, fuller lashes, and a glossy statement lip, in about 26 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, satin medium
steps.tip: Press foundation on in thin layers until the skin looks even and the age spots are softened. Build only where needed so the face keeps a natural medium depth.

steps.title: Concealer, bright sand
steps.tip: Place concealer in a lifted triangle under each eye, then tap extra where dark circles and puffy eyes are strongest. Use a small dense brush first, then a sponge to melt the edges.

steps.title: Highlighter, lifted glow
steps.tip: Run the highlight in a vertical line down the center of the face and a touch across the cheek tops. This helps pull attention upward and makes the under-eye area look brighter.

steps.title: Contour, soft cheek carve
steps.tip: Hollow just under the cheekbones and blend back toward the hairline. Keep the placement clean so the cheek structure stays visible under the stronger eye makeup.

steps.title: Eyebrows, defined arch
steps.tip: Build the arch a little higher than your natural brow, then soften the front with a spoolie. Keep the tail crisp so the dramatic eye look feels intentional.

steps.title: Eye shadow, bronze sparkle
steps.tip: Pack the lighter shade on the lid and place the deeper shade into the crease. Blend upward with a fluffy brush so the cut shape stays sharp at the lash line but soft above.

steps.title: Eye liner, bold wing
steps.tip: Start the wing at the outer third of the eye and extend it upward toward the tail of the brow. Keep the inner line thin so the wing looks lifted instead of heavy.

steps.title: Eyelashes, dense upper
steps.tip: Set the densest part of the lash strip slightly past the center so the outer eye looks lifted. Pinch the base after it dries to blend the strip into your liner.

name: Golden Glow
description: A high-shine glam face with warm bronze, glowing skin, and a soft nude lip, in about 24 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, even medium
steps.tip: Apply a thin, even layer to smooth the complexion and tone down age spots. Concentrate the product where you need it most, then feather the rest outward.

steps.title: Concealer, light warm beige
steps.tip: Brighten the under-eye trough and inner corner with a small amount of concealer. Tap extra coverage over dark circles and puffy eyes, then stop before it creases.

steps.title: Bronzer, sunlit warmth
steps.tip: Sweep bronzer over the tops of the cheeks, temples, and a light touch over the nose bridge. This should look like warmth from sun, not a stripe.

steps.title: Blush, two-tone peach
steps.tip: Place the deeper shade on the outer cheek and the lighter shade closer to the apples. Blend the two together so the blush looks dimensional and lifted.

steps.title: Eyebrows, natural shape
steps.tip: Follow your own brow shape and fill only the thinner sections. Brush through after filling so the brows stay full but not blocky.

steps.title: Eye shadow, copper wash
steps.tip: Sweep the copper color over the lid and slightly above the crease for a warm glow. Keep the lower edge soft so the shimmer catches light without looking messy.

steps.title: Eyelashes, lifted wisps
steps.tip: Angle the outer lash clusters slightly upward to create a lifted cat-eye effect. Press the inner lashes flatter so the strip blends into your natural lash line.

steps.title: Lip color, nude caramel
steps.tip: Apply the nude caramel in a thin coat, then add a little more to the center of the lips for dimension. The gloss finish will tie the warm cheek and eye tones together.
